Lake Wappapello Trail is described as a 12.75-mile loop plus about 10 miles of connector trails to the Ozark Trail; overnight equestrian use is not allowed and some portions are closed to overnight camping; hikers should register at the trailhead or park office. Allison Cemetery Trail is described as about half a mile (approximate, not recorded as a figure). Lengths and uses for Asher Creek and Lake View were not stated in the sources found.
